ios.desc:
Stay on top of the 2026 season. Get live F1 race updates, detailed schedules, circuit maps, and driver standings, all in one place.

Whether you’re following every lap or planning your race weekend, this app has you covered:

• Countdown to the next Grand Prix  
• Live timing and real‑time driver positions  
• Full weekend schedule: practice, qualifying, and race times  
• Circuit maps with key details  
• Race results and championship standings  
• Global calendar with every round  
• Sleek dark mode design  

From Bahrain to Monaco to Japan, follow every corner, every overtake, and every moment on the podium.

This is not an official motorsport app.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/pit-stop-privacy-policy/inicio  
Terms and Conditions: https://sites.google.com/view/pit-stop-terms/inicio
